description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the launcher for an app demonstrating drawable tinting. It manages UI initialization, menu actions, and sets up logging functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android launcher activity that manages UI fragments, options menu, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and inserts a fragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items visibility and titles based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, notably toggling the log view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, attaching various log handlers and filters.
